name: Sun Shield Shirt
description: Our high-performance sun shirt offers UPF 50+ protection, blocking 98% of UV radiation. Lightweight and breathable, perfect for hiking and outdoor activities.

name: Trail Blazer Jacket
description: Water-resistant and windproof shell jacket with UPF 40 sun protection. Features adjustable hood, multiple pockets, and pit-zip ventilation.

name: Mountain Hike Pants
description: Durable stretch pants with UPF 50+ protection built into the fabric. Quick-dry technology and articulated knees for full range of motion on the trail.

name: CloudWeave T-Shirt
description: Ultra-lightweight tee made from recycled polyester. UPF 30 sun protection and moisture-wicking finish keeps you cool all day.

name: Alpine Fleece Pullover
description: Midlayer fleece with a cozy brushed interior. No sun protection but excellent insulation for cold-weather layering in the mountains.

name: SolarGuard Long-Sleeve
description: UPF 50+ long-sleeve shirt designed specifically for sun-intensive activities like fishing, paddling, and beach hiking. Flatlock seams reduce chafing.

name: TrekLight Shorts
description: Lightweight nylon shorts with UPF 40 protection and a built-in liner. Four pockets and an adjustable waistband for comfort on long hikes.

name: Base Camp Hoodie
description: French terry hoodie for campsite warmth. No UPF rating but ideal for layering at dawn and dusk when sun protection is less critical.

name: Summit Softshell
description: Stretchy softshell jacket with DWR coating. UPF 20 incidental protection; optimized for high-output alpine climbing.

name: Coastal Swim Shirt
description: Rash-guard style swim shirt with UPF 50+ protection. Stays comfortable in and out of the water, great for snorkeling and kayaking.
